title: Stalk of internal Hom for a finitely presented module
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space, let $\mathcal F$ be a finitely presented $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation], let $\mathcal G$ be an $\mathcal O_X$-module, and let $x\in X$. For the internal sheaf Hom $\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal F,\mathcal G)$ [def-pur-sheaf-hom], the canonical map $\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal F,\mathcal G)_x\to\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_{X,x}}(\mathcal F_x,\mathcal G_x)$, sending a germ of a local morphism to its induced stalk map, is an isomorphism.
